title: One more existential alternation
statement: Let $i$ be a natural number and let $L,L'$ be languages of binary strings. Suppose $L'\in\Pi_i^{\mathsf P}$. If there are natural numbers $B,b$ such that (i) for all strings $x,u$, membership of $\langle x,u\rangle$ in $L'$ implies $x\in L$, and (ii) every $x\in L$ has some witness $u$ with $|u|\le B(|x|+1)^b$ and $\langle x,u\rangle\in L'$, then $L\in\Sigma_{i+1}^{\mathsf P}$.
hypotheses_covered: Every $x\in L$ has a witness $u$ of length at most $B(|x|+1)^b$ with $\langle x,u\rangle\in L'$
